report.question: How do the cotangent momentum map and its generic centralizer tori explain the little Weyl group, the integral root datum, and equivariant automorphisms of a smooth complex spherical variety?
report.reading_scope: The complete official mathematical body, sections 1-6, all displayed formulas available in HTML, proofs and proof sketches, Erratum 3.7 and Lemma 3.8, three footnotes, bibliography, and publication/license metadata were read. The two image-only commutative diagrams were not independently transcribed; factorization statements were checked against accompanying text and the versioned connectedness supplement. Supplement math/0108069v1: section 1 and section 2 including Theorems 1.1, 2.2, 2.3 and 2.4 and the proof of 2.4 read; the beginning of section 3 through the partial-compactification construction was consulted. Sections 4-5 and the complete connectedness proof were not read. The 1990, 1994 and 1996 source papers are cited through the main report, not claimed as independently read. Direct official AMS PDF retrieval returned 403.
report.coverage_status: 35 atomic knowledge pages, one narrative outline, one reference. Detailed core is smooth complex spherical cotangent geometry, not compact multiplicity-free classification. General quasiaffine Theorem 3.2 retained without a spherical restriction in 2W0X.

proof_scope.2W01: Definition with explicit complex-linear dual, equivariance and the house convention i_X omega=-dH; no compactness or properness assumption.
proof_scope.2W02: Proves the cotangent momentum formula by invariance of the tautological form, Cartan's formula, and an explicit equivariance calculation.
proof_scope.2W03: Proves kernel=orbit symplectic orthogonal, the rank formula and the infinitesimally-free submersion consequence by linear algebra.
proof_scope.2W04: Defines geometric multiplicity-free as generic coisotropicity and proves invariant Hamiltonian functions Poisson commute. Does not claim the converse or compact classification.
proof_scope.2W05: Defines normal spherical varieties, torus embeddings and homogeneous notation; proves B-invariant rational functions are constant from the dense orbit.
proof_scope.2W06: Proves uniqueness of same-weight rational semi-invariants; derives multiplicity-freeness using explicitly cited characteristic-zero complete reducibility and highest-weight theory.
proof_scope.2W07: Defines the weight lattice, torus and parameter vector space; proves multiplicative/additive and basis-independent interpretation. The quasiaffine regular-weight generation statement is cited from the report.
proof_scope.2W08: Defines multiplication differences, root lattice, cone and saturation; explicitly distinguishes saturation in the root lattice from saturation in the full weight lattice.
proof_scope.2W09: Proves the equivariant automorphism formula for affine spherical varieties by scalar endomorphisms, highest-weight products and coordinate-ring duality. Does not silently assert that every automorphism of an affine closure preserves an arbitrary open subset.
proof_scope.2W0A: Defines the valuation map and proves it is well-defined and additive on weights. Injectivity, finite polyhedrality and the full valuation/multiplication-cone correspondence are cited spherical-valuation inputs; only the sign calculation is local.
proof_scope.2W0B: Proves boundary valuation of Laurent polynomials and its extension to fractions, one-parameter limits, and the sign change caused by inverse pullback on functions. Toroidal condition is supplied locally.
proof_scope.2W0C: Proves additivity and basis independence of logarithmic differentials and the local extension calculation along a stable smooth divisor; fixes inverse-pullback signs explicitly, with character differentiation restricted to Lie(B), or Lie(P) for a P-semi-invariant.
proof_scope.2W0D: States the nondegenerate homogeneous spherical local-structure theorem with its regular-character, Levi and quotient-torus conditions. The existence of the slice and boundary extension are cited, not reconstructed.
proof_scope.2W0E: Requires W to act on A by group automorphisms. Gives the fixed-Weil-restriction functor argument. Representability, affineness and smoothness use the exact cited structural inputs; no unproved arbitrary-scheme smoothness assertion is derived locally.
proof_scope.2W0F: Works over every complex test algebra to derive a^2-sb^2=1, the multiplication, identity and inverse, and verifies the group axioms via multiplication in R[t]/(t^2-s).
proof_scope.2W0G: Proves relative Jacobian nonvanishing and explicitly identifies nonzero fibers with G_m and the zero fiber with mu_2 times G_a. Uses the relative hypersurface Jacobian criterion.
proof_scope.2W0H: Proves global sections are fixed constants under the invertible-functions hypothesis; independently solves all polynomial sections in rank one.
proof_scope.2W0I: Derives the distinction between reflection-fixed and root-fixed points; computes both rank-one root data and states the scheme-theoretic equivariance condition.
proof_scope.2W0J: Cites root-data classification of affine open subgroup schemes and reflection quotient finite flatness; computes the deleted negative component in rank one. Does not assert that every open subgroup is affine.
proof_scope.2W0K: Solves the SL2 centralizer equations over arbitrary complex test algebras. The general Kostant section and universal-centralizer/root-datum identification are cited, not proved.
proof_scope.2W0L: Derives Lie J as the invariant module with dual numbers and proves the rank-one invariant differential calculation. General descent of differentials is the cited Solomon theorem.
proof_scope.2W0M: States the normalized invariant momentum factorization and little Weyl group in the nondegenerate homogeneous spherical setting. Finiteness, normalization identification and generic irreducibility are cited research results.
proof_scope.2W0N: Uses the cited generic stabilizer pair (L,L0) and local structure, then proves the coisotropicity conclusion by an explicit dimension and differential-kernel calculation.
proof_scope.2W0O: Cites the monodromy identification and Brion-Knop reflection-chamber theorem, labels the deformation argument as an outline, and proves the rank-one square-root monodromy inversion.
proof_scope.2W0P: Cites global integration of the fiberwise identity component; explains the global symplectic-dual vector field mechanism. Distinguishes arbitrary one-forms from exact Hamiltonians. No complete formal-to-algebraic integration or compactification proof is claimed.
proof_scope.2W0Q: Cites maximal acting subgroup and unique root datum; explains the section/automorphism relation using the established section computation. Full maximality and extension proofs remain external.
proof_scope.2W0R: Proves Aut^G(G/H)=N_G(H)/H, including inverse convention, well-definedness, kernel and surjectivity via equality of stabilizers.
proof_scope.2W0S: Cites the primitive-root automorphism injection and wonderful-embedding criterion. Proves that vanishing of the character group forces the root lattice to equal the weight lattice by explicit linear-functional and inverse-matrix arguments.
proof_scope.2W0T: Calculates torus cotangent coordinates, symplectic form, moment map, Lagrangian fibers, zero multiplication differences and the constant acting group scheme. Shows nonproperness for positive rank.
proof_scope.2W0U: Calculates the lifted G_m action and xy moment map, classifies nonzero and zero fibers, and proves the latter is connected, reducible and singular with three group orbits.
proof_scope.2W0V: Uses the cited homogeneous spherical identification, spherical-harmonic irreducible decomposition and highest-weight bound; proves parity of every multiplication difference, exhibits 2alpha via q=1, and calculates the lattice, cone and mu2 automorphisms.
proof_scope.2W0W: States exactly the connected-fiber theorem for normalized invariant cotangent momentum maps of smooth connected G-varieties in characteristic zero. No compactness, sphericality, properness or irreducibility of special fibers is added. Research proof remains external.
proof_scope.2W0X: Retains Theorem 3.2 for arbitrary quasiaffine G-varieties with isotypic, possibly non-simple components. Records Erratum 3.7 and Lemma 3.8 and their proof mechanism, not a complete proof. Corrects additive central-valuation triviality to zero.
proof_scope.2W0Y: Proves the logarithmic cotangent bundle of (P1,{0,infinity}) is trivial, computes the extended torus action and boundary vector fields; properness uses the standard projective-morphism theorem. Makes no analogous claim for arbitrary noncommutative groups.
proof_scope.2W0Z: Checks the complex trace form on sl2 by its 3x3 Gram matrix, computes the traceless rank-one moment matrix and its quadratic invariant; proves the two generic components and irreducibility of each via overlapping affine-bundle charts, and proves connectivity of the zero fiber by contraction. Identifies the normalization example as cited.

remaining_branches: Complete proofs of the Weil restriction and fixed-point smoothness inputs, reflection-invariant differential theorem, and affine-open-subgroup classification are external.
The full BLV local structure proof and all spherical valuation/embedding classification inputs are not reconstructed.
Brion's reflection-chamber theorem is stated with a mechanism outline; the full degeneration/monodromy comparison is not proved here.
The 1996 formal-to-algebraic global J-action proof, the codimension-one extension mechanism, and maximality of J_X remain cited research inputs.
Wonderful compactification existence and the smoothness criterion remain cited; only the lattice consequence of the automorphism injection is proved locally.
The general nonspherical central-valuation and central-automorphism theory is represented by 2W0X, not developed into a second full branch.
Full connectedness proof of math/0108069v1 and questions about flatness or reducedness for general Hamiltonian varieties are not imported.
Relative Langlands duality, Sakellaridis-Venkatesh applications and compact multiplicity-free Hamiltonian classification are outside this branch.

terminology.house: Reuse 群概形 012L, 约化群 012M, 根数据 0187, 环面 01E2, Hamilton 向量场 0BL5, 固有态射 01FZ. 动量映射 is explicitly aliased to the existing application term 矩映射. Toroidal and wonderful retained with local mathematical definitions rather than an unverified translated standard.
terminology.signs: omega=d lambda, i_XH omega=-dH as in 0BL2/0BL5. Function action g.f=f(g^{-1}x); for xi in Lie(B), geometric orbit derivatives of a B-semi-invariant evaluate as -dchi(xi), with the analogous restriction to Lie(P) for P-semi-invariants. This changes the logarithmic-slice parameter sign only, not lattices or reflection groups.
terminology.scope: All group-scheme main results are in characteristic zero, with connected reductive G. Smoothness of X is required for cotangent symplectic geometry. Theorem 3.2 is separately stated for arbitrary quasiaffine X. Neither compactness nor properness is assumed for the original momentum map.
